name: The Great Aether Boom
description: The era of frenzied invention and celebration spurred by plane-wide availability of refined aether.

timeline.summary: Plane-wide availability of aether spurs the Great Aether Boom, a time of frenzied invention.
timeline.quote: It was a time of frenzied invention, boundless hope, and wondrous celebration.

pages_say.description: The technological leap that launched Kaladesh's current age of innovation six decades earlier.
